summary: Bug-fix retest of the mobile Delete button in Admin Dashboard 'Manage Fish'. Verified on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900) viewports. All flows PASSED: mobile card view renders with visible & clickable Delete, Edit and Toggle buttons; desktop table view still functional. Delete is confirmed against backend (GET /api/fish shows count decreases by 1). Bug fix is CONFIRMED WORKING.
action_items: OPTIONAL / NICE-TO-HAVE: The same data-testid (e.g. `delete-fish-{id}`, `edit-fish-{id}`, `toggle-avail-{id}`) is rendered in BOTH the desktop table block and the mobile card block. At any viewport, one of them is display:none but is still in the DOM. Playwright's `query_selector` therefore returns the hidden one first, and a naive automated test may click a hidden element and appear to fail. Consider making testids viewport-specific (e.g. `delete-fish-mobile-{id}` and `delete-fish-desktop-{id}`) OR render only one block conditionally (avoid rendering the hidden one) so tests and screen-reader tools see a single, unambiguous element per fish. Currently NOT breaking real users, only testing ergonomics.

MINOR / NON-BLOCKING: React console warning on /admin page — 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AdminLogin)'. Points to a setState-in-render inside AdminLogin.jsx. No functional impact, but should be cleaned up (wrap navigate/setState inside useEffect).
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid across desktop-table and mobile-card blocks in AdminDashboard.jsx (lines 200-204 vs 243-247). Any HTML with duplicate IDs / testids is not ideal for a11y and testing.

AdminDashboard.jsx is ~378 lines and mixes list rendering, edit modal, add-fish modal, notice tab and settings tab. Consider splitting into smaller components (FishListDesktop, FishListMobile, FishEditModal) — file is trending toward the 700-line soft limit.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 5 fish via POST /api/admin/fish (Rohu, Bangda, Surmai, Rawas, Pomfret) to reach the expected baseline of 6. After tests, re-added 2 fish (Pomfret, Bangda) so final /api/fish count is 6. Note: 2 duplicate Bangda now exist — cosmetic, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The delete-fish bug on mobile is FIXED and verified. Key testing note: because the same data-testid is present in BOTH the desktop table (hidden md:block) and the mobile card view (md:hidden), Playwright's `query_selector` will grab the hidden element first. Always iterate query_selector_all and pick the one whose bounding_box is non-null / width>0. Login flow: POST /api/auth/login with {email,password} — server returns {token,...} and sets httpOnly cookie. Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca of the issue: Original bug (already fixed by main agent): the fish list on mobile used a single <table> wrapped in a div with `overflow-hidden`, which clipped the rightmost 'Actions' column (Edit/Delete) off-screen at <768px viewport. Fix implemented: `hidden md:block` for the table (desktop) + a new `md:hidden` card layout (mobile) with grid-cols-2 Edit/Delete touch targets and matching data-testid. Verified working at 390x844 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop). Deletes propagate to backend and UI updates immediately.
